finding.what: kit/changes A_E6 (the SSCTR R7ASM changes probe): after a moderate first break, return steps 0 and 1 executed and the completion released but never run, a moderate second break (14 days) resumed return step 1 (30/30/45 min) instead of re-entering from the 15-minute entry (15/15/20) as the predecessor did. Cause: E1 undid the released completion for every break class, and the moderate recipe keeps a RETURN or RESTART state as it is. The same held after a restart switch released and never run (restart minutes resumed). Under the ceiling (30/45 had been executed) but against R6-NONCLINICAL-RETURN's moderate recipe (re-entry from a current demonstration or the 15-minute entry).
finding.fix: stateAtBreak passes the break class: a short break undoes every release (resume the last executed doses), a moderate or long one only the walk/jog exit (SSCTR R46); the released easy state, capped at the doses executed since the entry, then takes the moderate or long recipe.
